const-arrow.what: an arrow held by a module-level const, read as a declaration is

forward-declaration.what: a function or alias used before it is declared

number.what: number parameters and results: the integers for Lean, doubles for SMT

string.what: string literals (escapes decoded), and + joining two strings

string-literal-union.what: a union of string literals, read as string

arithmetic.what: + - * on numbers; a product of two variables is read but beyond linear arithmetic

const-binding.what: a const binding in a body

if-early-return.what: if and if/else with early returns

local-call.what: a call to a function of the module

inlined-call.what: a call to a generic function, or one imported from another file, read at each call

record.what: a record type (interface or object type alias): literals and field reads

inline-object-type.what: an inline object type in a signature

contextual-record-type.what: a record literal typed by its context when two aliases share a shape

keyword-names.what: names that are Lean keywords (from, end)

generic-alias.what: a generic type alias, instantiated where it is used

imported-type.what: a type imported from another file of the project

nullable.what: T | null, narrowed by === null and !== null

tagged-union.what: a union of records with a tag field, narrowed by testing the tag

record-in-several-unions.what: one member record in two unions, moving between them

conditional-tag.what: a union member's tag chosen by a conditional inside the literal

truthiness-null-test.what: truthiness of a nullable record or union (a condition, or under !) as a null test

list.what: readonly T[] as a list: literals with a trailing spread, length, xs[0] ?? d, slice(1), map, flatMap, every, some, reduce

structural-recursion.what: recursion on a list parameter's slice(1) after testing its length against 0

supplied-proof.what: a Lean file beside the spec file supplying proofs the tactic script does not find

loop-and-mutable-binding.what: a loop or a let binding: outside the subset

general-recursion.what: recursion other than structural recursion on a list: outside the subset

regex-precondition.what: a regex test in a spec's when: outside the subset

truthiness-of-primitives.what: truthiness of a nullable number or string, which is not a null test: outside the subset

collections.what: for...of, Set and other collections beyond the list operations: outside the subset
